paite: Aw Jakob inkuan, Aw Israel min kikoppih, Judah tuite a pan a pawt, thutak hilou, diktatna ah hi sam lou, TOUPA min lou a kichiam a, Israel' Pathian min lou zelte aw, hiai ngaikhia un.
heading: Pathian, Tunung TOUPA Ahi
english: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come forth out of the waters of Judah; who swear by the name of Yahweh, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness

paite: Khopi siangthou a mi akichi ngal ua, Israel' Pathian tung ah ginna anga ua; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: (for they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves on the God of Israel; Yahweh of Armies is his name):

paite: Atung a kipan in thil masate ka gen a; ahi, ka kam a kipan in apawt a, ka theisak a; thakhat in ka tangtungsak guih a, ahong tung hi.
english: I have declared the former things from of old; yes, they went forth out of my mouth, and I showed them: suddenly I did them, and they happened.

paite: Migenhak na hi uh, na ngawng uh sik tha ahi, na tal uh dal ahi chih ka theih ziak in,
english: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow brass;

paite: Nidanglai a kipan na kiang uah ka genta; ahong tun ma in na kiang uah ka hon theisakta hi; huchi lou in zaw, "Ka milim in ahih ahi, ka milim bawltawm leh ka milim sun in thu apiak ahi,” na chi kha ding uh.
english: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them, and my engraved image, and my molten image, has commanded them.’

paite: "Na zata uh, hiaite tengteng en un, noumau na genta kei ding ua hia? Tua kipan in thil thak ka hon theisak ding a, thil kisel na theih ngeilouhte uh.
english: You have heard it; see all this; and you, will you not declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.

paite: Huaite nidanglai a siam hilou in, tu a siam ahi; tuni ma in na bil un na za ngei kei uh; huchi lou in zaw, 'Ngai in, huaite i theihsa ahi, na chi kha ding uh.’
english: They are created now, and not from of old; and before this day you didn’t hear them; lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’

paite: Ahi, na bil un na za ngei kei ua; ahi, na lungsim un na thei ngei kei uh, ahi, nidanglai a kipan in na bil uh hon in a-om ngei kei him hi; lepchiahtak in na hih zel uh chih leh, sul a kipan in talek mi ahon chi him uh chih lah ka thei ngal a.
english: Yes, you didn’t hear; yes, you didn’t know; yes, from of old your ear was not opened: for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and was called a transgressor from the womb.

paite: "K'on hihmanlouhna ding in ka min ziak in ka hehna ka hawi lai ding a, phat ka lohna ding in na tung uah ka kidek ding.
english: For my name’s sake will I defer my anger, and for my praise will I refrain for you, that I not cut you off.

paite: Ngai un, ka hon hihsiang ahi, himahleh dangka hihsiang bang in ahi kei; haksatna haltuina mei ah ka hon chian hi.
english: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

paite: Kei leh kei ziak in, ahi, kei leh kei ziak lel in ahi ka hih ding; bang ding in ka min suksiat in a-om dia? Ka thupina midang kiang ah ka pe kei ding.
english: For my own sake, for my own sake, will I do it; for how should my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.

paite: Jakob leh ka sap Israel aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; kei amah ka hi; amasapen ka hi, ananungpen leng ka hi.
heading: Kupra, TOUPA Tel Heutu
english: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

paite: Ahi, ka khut in lei kingakna aphum a, ka khut taklam in avante akaipalh a; ka saptak in adingkhawm zel uh.
english: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens: when I call to them, they stand up together.

paite: "Noute aw, kikhawm unla, ngaikhia un; alak uah kua'n hiai thil agen dia? TOUPA'N amah a-it a; ama'n Babulon tung ah adeihlam ahih ding a, Kaldaite tung ah aban lik in a-om ding.
english: “Assemble yourselves, all you, and hear; who among them has declared these things? He whom Yahweh loves shall perform his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

paite: Kei, keimah ngei in, thu ka genta; ahi, amah ka sam a, ka pi a, alampi alamzangsak ding.
english: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

paite: Noute'n hon naih unla, hiai ngaikhia un; atung a kipan in asim in thu ka gen ngei kei; a-om tung lai a kipan in huai ah ka om; tu in Toupa PATHIAN in keimah leh ama Kha hon sawlta hi."
english: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it was, there am I.” Now the Lord Yahweh has sent me, with his Spirit.

paite: TOUPA, nou hon tanpa, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi: "Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh, na hoihna ding ua hon chilpa, na paina ding lampi ua hon pipa ka hi."
heading: Amite Dia TOUPA Thilgel
english: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

paite: "Aw noute'n ka thupiakte na ngaikheta hi le uchin, na tung ua lemna lui bang mai a om ding a, na diktatna uh tuipi kihawtte bang mai a om ding hiven maw;
english: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea:

paite: Na suante uh piaunel zah pha ding ua, na gil ua gahte leng piaunel mal neu chikchik zah a pha ding ua; amin uh ka ma a kipan thaimang in a-om kei ding, hihman in leng a om sam kei ding," chi in.
english: your seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of your body like its grains: his name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.

paite: "Babilon a kipan pawt unla, Kaldaite taimangsan un; hiai lasak husa in genzak in, hilh unla, kawlmong pha in gingsak un, TOUPA'N asikha Jakobte atanta!" chi un.
english: Go forth from Babylon, flee from the Chaldeans; with a voice of singing declare, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth: say, Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob.

paite: Gamdai a api lai in adangtak kei ua; suangpi a pan in amaute a ding in tuite aluangkhesak a; suangpi aphelkhap a, huchi in tui ahong pawtkhia hi.
english: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts; he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; he split the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

paite: "TOUPA'N, mithulimloute a ding in muanna himhim a-om kei," achi hi.
english: “There is no peace,” says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”
